messages:
Amy L.: quick heads-up — ran a cross-region long-ctx benchmark for Llama/Mistral/Qwen (rope vs GQA variants) up to 256k tokens. uploading summary here.
Omar K.: awesome. which GPUs/regions? and did you test quantized configs?
Amy L.: tested A100 (us-east-1), H100 (eu-west-1), and A10G (ap-southeast-1). ran fp16, int8(q4_0), and q8_0-ish profiles. kernels: flash-attn, rope-opt, gqa-fused-v2.
Devon: tl;dr numbers please (p50/p95 latency + tokens/sec).
Amy L.: short summary:
- Llama-70B fp16, A100 us-east: p50 220ms (1k toks), p95 620ms; throughput ~12k toks/s steady with flash-attn + rope-opt.
- Llama-70B int8 (q4_0) on A100: p50 170ms, p95 510ms; throughput ~18k toks/s but small quality drop on synthetic QA eval (~1.8% em drop).
- Mistral-34B fp16 on H100 eu-west: p50 140ms, p95 390ms; throughput ~22k toks/s with gqa-fused.
- Qwen-30B longctx 131k on A10G ap-southeast: p50 430ms, p95 1.2s; throughput ~6k toks/s — rope-opt fallback occurred intermittently.
Nina S.: for the rope-opt fallback, any logs? sounds like kernel not matching sequence parity.
Amy L.: yes. snippet from runtime logs:
```
[2026-03-18T14:12:03Z] kernel_select: attempted rope-opt v1 -> incompatible for seq_len 65536 on A10G, fallback to generic-rope (3.1x slower)
```
Ryan M.: that explains the 3x latency spike. do we have a CPU-hosted fallback or does it stay on GPU?
Amy L.: GPU fallback (generic kernel) — still on GPU but much higher memory thrash.
Omar K.: how about across regions — any network/serialization overhead?
Amy L.: negligible for local perf tests — inference-only payloads. region differences driven by GPU and kernel availability (H100 builds had gqa-fused compiled).
Devon: where are the plots? can you drop p50/p95 charts and a small table for capacity sizing (req qps -> required GPUs)?
Amy L.: uploaded plots + raw csv to S3: s3://redwood-perf/bench/1769904321/ (perf-bot will link).
perf-bot: artifact uploaded -> https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-perf/bench/1769904321/results.tar.gz :thumbsup:
Nina S.: any quality regressions from quant? you said 1.8% EM drop for Llama int8 — test set?
Amy L.: evaluation on internal GQA-like suite (~8k examples). drop concentrated on long-range coreference cases. Mistral int8 showed <0.5% drop. Qwen q8-ish had sporadic hallucinations at >64k context, probably due to KV precision loss.
Ryan M.: actionable items?
Omar K.: 1) add kernel parity checks in build matrix for A10G so rope-opt compiles for large seqs, 2) add early-detect to route >64k Qwen requests to H100 pool, 3) run targeted evals for long-range co-ref on quantized Llama.
Amy L.: agreed. I'll open tickets and schedule a follow-up bench after kernel rebuild.
Devon: thanks — can we also include a small capacity table in the ticket: e.g., 100 qps at 1k token Llama-70B fp16 -> N GPUs? (approx).
Amy L.: rough numbers in ticket will have: fp16 A100 ~8 qps per GPU @1k toks; int8 ~12 qps; H100 Mistral ~18 qps. I'll add exact csv.
Nina S.: nice. cc @infra for kernel CI.
Amy L.: tagging infra in the tickets. thanks all. :rocket:
